title: Report check: a played pawn loots corpses, incl. a harnessed ox (DPC 0.9.173)
intro: A player's game crashed right after his played pawn looted a dead harnessed ox (oxcart ox, ch299003_A_10). His load order has several loot mods; ours has none. SAVE THE GAME FIRST: this may crash. Open ground outdoors, playing the Arisen, co-op off, at least two pawns, no enemies near. The test spawns a target in front of the pawn you play each time; you kill it and loot it with DPC's 'Loot the body' prompt (Interact). If the game crashes, just restart and tell Claude which step it was. About 4 minutes. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1/5 Control: you now play your MAIN pawn. A goblin stands still 5 m ahead. Kill it, walk up, press Interact on 'Loot the body'. End once looted.
2/5 The reported case: a HARNESSED OX (oxcart ox) stands 5 m ahead. Kill it, then loot it as the main pawn. End once looted (or restart if the game crashes).

expect.label: the pawn looted the harnessed ox

steps.text: 3/5 A plain ox (no harness) 5 m ahead. Kill it, loot it. End once looted.

expect.label: the pawn looted the plain ox

steps.text: 4/5 Now you play your SECOND (hired) pawn. Another harnessed ox 5 m ahead. Kill it, loot it. End once looted.

expect.label: the hired pawn looted the harnessed ox

steps.text: 5/5 Done, no crash. Check the played pawn's inventory has the loot if you like. Back to the Arisen; End to finish.

probes.looted: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.int_n or 0) or -1
probes.near: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.int_name) or ''
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing ' .. tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
